title_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Tek "Eagle Rezidence", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt !!
description_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Tek "Eagle Rezidence", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri te Rregullt!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje ndertimi te ri aktualisht ne faze perfundimtare. Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 123.1 m2, organizohet nga korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhoma e femijeve me ballkon me vete dhe tualeti i dites. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e ventiluar, dritare me dopjo xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim, izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve dhe sistem kondicionimi multisplit . Oborri i brendshem eshte nje hapesire e plotesuar me stola dhe gjelberim.
title_en: Clearing opportunity! At "Eagle Residence", 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! At "Eagle Residence", 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale, With Regular Floor Plan!! The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a new building currently in the final stage. The apartment with a total area of ​​123.1 m2 is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen area with access to the balcony, the matrimonial room with its own toilet, the children's room with its own balcony and the day toilet. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade, double-glazed windows with gas filling to minimize noise and thermal insulation, acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments and multisplit air conditioning system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery.
